summary: Comprehensive architectural and visual design plan for Velo Reglo (Maher Habouria's championship bicycle and e-bike workshop in Nabeul, Tunisia), featuring a frame-by-frame scrollytelling deconstruction, Light Industrial Studio + Park Tool Blue palette, trilingual support (FR / TN Derja / EN), interactive repair estimator with WhatsApp booking, and copy-paste AI prompts for custom PNG cutouts and scroll-scrubbed videos.
